all_fact_samples.value: Please note that the Designated Person(DP) has received these shares on exercise of 582 Restricted Stock Units under the HCL Technologies Limited - Restricted Stock Unit Plan. The DP has paid Rs. 2 /- per share as an exercise price to obtain these shares from HCL Technologies Stock Options Trust (“Trust”). The opening price of Rs. 1319.90 per share on NSE as on 21/08/2026 being the date of transfer of the said shares from the Trust to me, has been considered for the purpose of calculation of threshold value beyond which disclosure in Form B is required.

The XBRL filing was submitted on 3 September 2026 within the prescribed timeline. Under the transaction details, the transaction type was correctly reported as "Sell". However, due to an inadvertent clerical error, In serial number 2 and 3 the Mode of Acquisition/Disposal was incorrectly mentioned as "Market Purchase" instead of "Market Sale". The error is purely clerical in nature and does not affect any other information disclosed in the filing. Accordingly, the filing is being revised solely to amend the aforementioned discrepancy and ensure that the disclosure accurately reflects the transaction details.
